scope: Same true-FC2 sample0 stage0/3 tensors already screened; explicitly an implementation follow-up, not a new blind cohort or new idea.
reason: Avoid single-class member-list traversal and its class-serial bank request order. Retain source order and construct bounded partial signature sums.
algorithm: Visit original source channels in ascending order. Silent sources skip. Single-time signatures update their one destination directly. Multi-time signatures use a fully associative LRU dictionary of D wide partial sums keyed by full T signature. A hit adds current phi=theta*W to its partial. A miss assigns the incoming phi to a free slot; if full, first scatter the LRU partial to all indicated T outputs, invalidate it, then assign incoming phi. After all C source channels, drain all resident entries in LRU order. Repeated signature after eviction creates a new segment; do not claim one whole-class reduction.
state: D wide signature partials, plus at most two separately reserved wide pipeline/flush registers, and T persistent output vectors with valid flags. D=8 plus two fits a ten-working-vector budget for this abstract scalar-event reference. All source data are full-T flags already available; producer overlap is not assumed.
cost: Charge one coefficient-vector read per non-silent source, one key comparison per current valid dictionary entry per multi-time source, wide partial assignment/update/read for flush, destination writes and additions using persistent global output-valid flags. Flushed contributions and later direct bypasses share those same valid flags. No per-segment first-output-add discount.
replacement: LRU on every class hit or insertion; a drain sends all consumers before freeing slot. Class value zero due to signed cancellation remains valid and is sent normally.
bank_boundary: Coefficient request identities retain original ascending-source order; they are not regrouped by signature. This removes the compulsory class-major permutation, but bank issue concurrency is NOT proven: simultaneous same-class updates, dictionary ports, eviction drains and output backpressure can still stall.
nearest_prior: This is a finite selective-partial-sum / RSR implementation variant and overlaps local SSR/M2271. Do not count it as another novel algebra or independent third contribution.
diagnostics: Same64 spatial positions per stage as FC2 signature receipt, eight diagnostic lanes, non-1 rational theta and signed INT8 W. Exact full T comparison; directed cache churn, A-B-A return, single-time bypass interleaving, signed cancellation and all-silent cases.
claim_boundary: CPU event reference only; no RTL cycles, area, power, new AEE or checkpoint FP32 equivalence.
